parts.name: rules-of-engagement
parts.title: Rules of engagement
parts.prose: Scans and tests only on the six pre-production stations at the test range; never on the brigade enclave, a fielded station, a powered aircraft or a radiating GDT. Credentialed scans use an assessor account the ISSO creates and removes. The ISSM and brigade S6 get 48 hours notice before any scan; the ISSO may halt testing for safety. Findings go to the ISSM daily and no data leaves the test range.

parts.name: assessment-team
parts.title: Assessment team
parts.prose: PER-SCA (Lead assessor and SCA of record (Aviation Systems SCA team), independent); PER-SCA (Technical assessor: scans and technical tests, independent); PER-PRIV (Privacy analyst from the Component privacy officer's staff: pt controls and Privacy Overlay, independent)
